title: A henselian colimit of pointed etale neighbourhoods is the henselization
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $\mathfrak p\subset A$ a prime ideal with residue field $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-weil-residue-field]. Let $I$ be a nonempty directed set and $(A_a)_{a\in I}$ a directed system of $A$-algebras with colimit $H$ and colimit maps $\lambda_a:A_a\to H$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Assume that each $\operatorname{Spec}A_a\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is separated etale of finite presentation [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], that $H$ is a henselian local ring [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_H=\mathfrak pH$, and that for every $a$ the prime $\mathfrak p_a=\lambda_a^{-1}(\mathfrak m_H)$ lies over $\mathfrak p$ and $\kappa(\mathfrak p)\to\kappa(\mathfrak p_a)$ is an isomorphism. Then: (1) the induced map $A_{\mathfrak p}\to H$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is local and makes $H$ a henselization of $A_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-henselization-at-prime]; (2) for every $a$, the map $(A_a)_{\mathfrak p_a}\to H$ induced by $\lambda_a$ is local and makes $H$ a henselization of $(A_a)_{\mathfrak p_a}$; (3) for every $a$ and every $n\geq1$ the induced maps $A_{\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak p^nA_{\mathfrak p}\to(A_a)_{\mathfrak p_a}/\mathfrak p_a^n(A_a)_{\mathfrak p_a}\to H/\mathfrak m_H^n$ are ring isomorphisms; hence $A_{\mathfrak p}$, $(A_a)_{\mathfrak p_a}$ and $H$ have canonically isomorphic maximal-ideal completions [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], compatibly with the maps between these rings. No Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 08HT (lemma-uniqueness-henselian), with Lemmas 04GN (lemma-henselization) and 04GV (lemma-henselization-different): a henselian local filtered colimit of etale algebras with the given residue field is the henselization; used for ILO V 2.2.7 and 3.2.4, pp.65--68, where the henselized cylinder is written as a filtered colimit of finite type algebras.
